info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Update Loan Details API
info.description: The Update Loan Details API allows financial institutions to modify existing loan information for customers, ensuring that all data is up-to-date and accurate. This endpoint supports operations such as adjusting loan terms, interest rates, or payment schedules based on customer requests or policy updates. Typical consumers include loan officers, customer service representatives, or any financial applications needing to maintain current loan records. By utilizing this API, businesses can enhance customer experience through timely updates and adjustments to loan agreements.

patch.summary: Update loan details for a specific loan.
patch.description: This endpoint allows you to update the relevant details of a specific loan identified by its ID. Use this operation to adjust parameters like repayments, interest rates, or other attributes associated with the loan.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to update the details of loan LOAN-500045 through a PATCH request. It allows for partial updates to the loan's data.

200.description: The loan details were updated successfully.
